graph_carrier.signature: pub fn graph_carrier( num_nodes: usize, edges: &[(usize, usize)], triangles: &[(usize, usize, usize)], weights: Vec<Q>, ) -> Result<Carrier, CarrierError>
graph_carrier.body: { let indices = edge_indices(num_nodes, edges)?; let mut d0 = BasicMatrix::<Q>::zero(edges.len(), num_nodes)?; for (i, &(src, tgt)) in edges.iter().enumerate() { d0.set(i, src, q(-1))?; d0.set(i, tgt, q(1))?; } let d1 = triangle_boundary(num_nodes, edges.len(), triangles, &indices)?; Carrier::new(num_nodes, edges.len(), triangles.len(), d0, d1, weights) }
graph_carrier.obligation: Validate/index directed edges first; checked E-by-N zero matrix receives -1 at distinct source and +1 at target. Build T-by-E d1; re-admit values, law and ranks through core. Huge zero area succeeds; huge nonzero product meets checked matrix allocation refusal.

triangle_boundary.signature: fn triangle_boundary( num_nodes: usize, num_edges: usize, triangles: &[(usize, usize, usize)], indices: &BTreeMap<(usize, usize), usize>, ) -> Result<BasicMatrix<Q>, CarrierError>
triangle_boundary.body: { let mut d1 = BasicMatrix::<Q>::zero(triangles.len(), num_edges)?; for (i, &(a, b, c)) in triangles.iter().enumerate() { admit_triangle(num_nodes, i, (a, b, c))?; for (src, tgt, sign) in [(a, b, 1), (b, c, 1), (a, c, -1)] { let col = indices .get(&(src, tgt)) .ok_or(CarrierError::TriangleMissingEdge { triangle: i, src, tgt, })?; d1.set(i, *col, q(sign))?; } } Ok(d1) }
triangle_boundary.obligation: Checked T-by-E allocation. Validate triangle before ordered ab,bc,ac lookups; preserve first missing-edge payload. Distinct vertices imply distinct ordered pairs/columns, so checked set(+1,+1,-1) equals indicator sum. Enumerated row/map column are in range. Duplicate triangle rows remain separate rows.

edge_indices.signature: fn edge_indices( num_nodes: usize, edges: &[(usize, usize)], ) -> Result<BTreeMap<(usize, usize), usize>, CarrierError>
edge_indices.body: { let mut indices = BTreeMap::new(); for (i, &(src, tgt)) in edges.iter().enumerate() { admit_edge(num_nodes, i, src, tgt)?; if indices.insert((src, tgt), i).is_some() { return Err(CarrierError::BasisMismatch { description: "parallel directed edges".into(), }); } } Ok(indices) }
edge_indices.obligation: Validate before insertion; duplicate directed pair returns BasisMismatch. Successful map contains exactly input pairs and distinct enumerated indices<E. Opposite pairs differ. Partial local data drops on failure.

admit_edge.signature: fn admit_edge(n: usize, edge: usize, src: usize, tgt: usize) -> Result<(), CarrierError>
admit_edge.body: { if src >= n { return Err(CarrierError::EdgeSourceOutOfRange { edge, src }); } if tgt >= n { return Err(CarrierError::EdgeTargetOutOfRange { edge, tgt }); } if src == tgt { return Err(CarrierError::SelfLoopNotAllowed { node: src }); } Ok(()) }
admit_edge.obligation: Reject source>=N first, target>=N second, then self loop. Exact full usize payloads, no arithmetic/narrowing or unchecked indexing.

admit_triangle.signature: fn admit_triangle( n: usize, triangle: usize, (a, b, c): (usize, usize, usize), ) -> Result<(), CarrierError>
admit_triangle.body: { for vertex in [a, b, c] { if vertex >= n { return Err(CarrierError::TriangleVertexOutOfRange { triangle, vertex }); } } if a == b || b == c || a == c { return Err(CarrierError::BasisMismatch { description: "triangle vertices must be distinct".into(), }); } Ok(()) }
admit_triangle.obligation: Check a,b,c against N in order before three pairwise inequality guards. Preserve first full-index error; any repeated vertex returns BasisMismatch.
